name: Ajman Bank
founded: 2008 (incorporated 17 Apr 2008; DFM listing 2008; operations began 22 Dec 2008)
ownership_summary: Listed on DFM. At 31 Dec 2025 the Government of Ajman held 33.10% and H.H. Sheikh Humaid bin Rashid Al Nuaimi (Ruler of Ajman) 15.98%; free float was 50.92%. The FY2025 earnings review describes 58% ownership by the Emirate of Ajman and the ruling family 'directly and indirectly'. No merger, recapitalisation or change of control found for 2024–2026. Capital actions were debt-based: a senior sukuk in 2025 and an inaugural USD 300m AT1 sukuk in Jul 2026.

shareholders.holder: H.H. Sheikh Humaid bin Rashid Al Nuaimi

government_link: Yes — the Government of Ajman holds 33.1% and the interim statements say the Group 'is controlled by Ajman Government' (30 Jun 2026). The Ruler of Ajman holds a further 15.98%, and the Crown Prince of Ajman chairs the board.
group_structure: Ajman Bank PJSC (fully Shariah-compliant). Subsidiaries are real-estate vehicles only: Skyrise Properties (100%, real-estate brokerage and property management, set up Jan 2024) and Makaseb 2 Real Estate Investment (86.6%). Wealth management, investment advisory, funds and sukuk trading sit inside the bank: the Wholesale segment covers 'investment solutions, wealth management' and Treasury & Capital Markets (TCM) runs advisory and sukuk. The bank says it holds no licence for discretionary portfolio management.

subsidiaries.name: Skyrise Properties (S.P.S - L.L.C)
subsidiaries.activity: Real estate brokerage and property management

footprint: UAE: head office in Ajman plus ten branches and two pay offices (30 Jun 2026 statements). The FY2025 earnings review counts 11 operating branches, 2 cash offices and 92 ATMs/CCDMs in Ajman, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Al Ain. New Dubai corporate office opened Jun 2026 (Emaar Business Park).
customer_segments: Consumer banking (personal and Priority Banking; mass-market savings and financing; Ajman government employees). Wealth Management aimed at entrepreneurs, business owners and UHNW founders. Wholesale: corporates, GREs, government and SMEs.
business_lines: Wholesale banking (51.4% of assets, Jun 2026; includes investment solutions and wealth management), consumer banking (14.7%; personal, priority, cards, home/auto/personal finance), treasury and capital markets (22.0%; sukuk trading, third-party Islamic funds, FX, advisory). All products are Shariah-compliant.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Ajman Bank is a fully Islamic bank with a small, mostly offline wealth business run between Consumer Banking (Priority Banking) and Treasury & Capital Markets. Priority Banking requires an AED 250k average balance, a AED 40k salary, an AED 80k takaful plan or AED 500k invested. Wealth Management targets entrepreneurs and UHNW founders. The shelf: Wakala-based third-party Islamic funds from AED 30,000 (Rasmala, Emirates NBD Asset Management, Mashreq Capital); Franklin Templeton Shariah funds, the Azimut Global Sukuk fund and BlackRock iShares MSCI World/EM Islamic ETFs listed in the 2026 wealth deck; a sukuk trading platform (130+ sukuk, USD 200k minimum, up to 2% upfront fee, 0.25% custody); and secured share financing for DFM/ADX stocks through third-party brokers. A May 2025 distribution agreement with Azimut (DIFC) gives clients global fixed-income products and investment strategies. The bank states it offers advisory and bespoke fixed-income portfolios but 'does not offer Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) services' because it lacks the licence. The FY2025 strategy lists 'Focus on building Ajman Wealth by offering value added solutions'. In 2026 a career private banker (ex-LGT, Bank of Singapore) became Acting Head of Consumer Banking. The Ajman Bank One app supports Wakala deposit booking but no investing.

brokerage.detail: Sukuk Trading: secondary-market buying and selling of 130+ global sukuk (USD 200k minimum, up to 2% upfront fee, 0.25% annual custody). Equities: Secured Share Finance (Wakala-based financing up to 100% of the portfolio) for selected DFM/ADX shares, traded through a network of third-party brokers chosen by the client. No in-house equity brokerage.

digital_investing.detail: Ajman Bank One app: onboarding, accounts, cards, financing, PFM, GenAI assistant 'Hamed' (Q4 2025) and STP Wakala deposit booking. Funds and sukuk are sold via treasury sales (phone/email); no in-app securities or funds investing found.
